features.summary: Factory firmware package generation plus stable BLE identity, DIS firmware/protocol fields, pairable-on-boot behavior, and BLE-readable readiness/capabilities strings.
validation: Manual BLE scan confirms name, appearance, DIS firmware/protocol, readiness, and capabilities
evidence: Factory package manifest records bootloader, partition table, app binary offsets, SHA256, git commit, version, and flash command
BLE custom audio service exposes read-only readiness and capabilities characteristics
invariants: Factory BLE name remains listener
Appearance remains keyboard 0x03C1
First power-on advertises without a serial command
POST critical failures log and continue into degraded BLE mode
known_limits: Generated binary package lives under .cache/factory_firmware and is not committed to git
Readiness and capabilities are static factory capability strings, not the full diagnostic package

features.summary: Git version injection + BLE DIS identity, non-blocking POST self-test, and host-side text injection via USB Serial JTAG (type + paste).
evidence: 2026-05-19 real-device PASS: master ab64c02, POST output normal, BLE DIS query, A1 matrix pass, type/paste injection verified
invariants: fw_version is git short hash injected at build time
POST is non-blocking and does not prevent boot on failure
inject_text.py requires USB Serial JTAG connection
known_limits: NVS POST reports FAIL on first boot (partition uninitialized)
inject_text.py uses pyautogui, requires target window focus

features.summary: KEY1 or serial toggle records 16 kHz mono PCM and uploads VKA1 sessions over BLE Notify for host WAV/PCM reconstruction.
evidence: archive/audio_capture_ble_upload_history.md records P1-P10 standard/realistic multi-seed PASS with matrix_failed=0 and matrix_warning=0
archive/audio_capture_ble_upload_history.md records real KEY1 manual acceptance without counting it as automated matrix
invariants: audio_data is a packet_sequence stream, not old chunk+fragment
host subscription order stays CCCD notify -> ValueChanged
subscribe-before-connect compatibility stays supported
known_limits: Raw PCM over BLE has limited RF margin
Windows WinRT may need recovery fallback

features.summary: BLE audio transport uses explicit state, connection epoch filtering, notify credits, fixed audio pool, backpressure, and summary logs.
evidence: archive/ble_audio_transport_hardening_history.md records fixed pool, queue/pool/drop summary, P1-P10 standard/realistic, 60s long session, and 10-round soak PASS
invariants: connection epoch filters stale subscribe/MTU/notify_tx/disconnect events
notify credits and tx completion must remain balanced
audio pool and transport summary counters must remain observable
known_limits: GATT Notify is not a reliable stream protocol
RF interference still needs external validation

features.summary: Standard BLE HID keyboard fallback/debug path sends ASCII or key reports to Windows.
evidence: archive/ble_hid_keyboard_output_history.md records 2026-05-13 real-device validation PASS
archive/ble_hid_keyboard_output_history.md records 3/3 reset + reconnect + typing regression PASS
invariants: Windows UI connected is not enough; require firmware logs or host capture
BLE HID remains fallback/debug, not the Chinese speech output path
known_limits: Depends on host focus and Windows Bluetooth state

features.summary: VKA1 session semantics provide a stable 16 kHz mono PCM input contract for desktop or backend consumers.
evidence: archive/voice_input_backend_contract_history.md records P1-P10 standard/realistic multi-seed PASS and matrix_failed=0/matrix_warning=0
invariants: backend consumes ordered PCM packets and checks expected_packet_count
missing packets must be reported or silence-filled, not silently ignored
firmware does not perform ASR, polishing, insertion history, or agent routing
known_limits: Current transport is BLE Notify; future transports should preserve session semantics

features.summary: Simplified BLE audio product-chain matrix with A1/A2 only: A1 rapid consecutive short recordings with the next round triggered within 0-1s after the previous text/history appears, A2 about-one-minute long recording with partial preview quality. Both cases run BLE -> ASR -> text insertion -> accuracy gate -> capsule evidence.
evidence: CASE_ORDER is A1,A2 and CASE_SUITES smoke/daily/full/auto all resolve to A1,A2
CASE_DESCRIPTIONS documents A1 rapid consecutive short recordings with <=1s post-text next-round trigger and A2 about-one-minute long recording
CASE_PRODUCT_CHAIN_AUDIO_PROFILES uses normal profile for A1/A2
ble_audio_regression_common.py remains the shared TTS/playback/BLE capture support library
verify_audio_ble_product_matrix.py adds validate_partial_preview_quality + validate_capsule_evidence
Capsule evidence checks partial_preview_count and last_partial_preview; warnings on failure, not hard fail
2026-06-04 matrix simplified from 28 cases to A1/A2 core product-chain gates
2026-06-05 matrix timing tightened: A1 records 0-1s inter_round_gaps and text_to_next_capsule_latencies, and A2 defaults to 14 clauses/about one minute
invariants: CASE_SUITES smoke/daily/full/auto all select A1,A2
--transport-only controls product-chain overlay only; the simplified matrix has no legacy transport suite
Each case tests one core user scenario dimension
A1 validates every rapid round independently, records a 0-1s inter_round_gaps window plus text_to_next_capsule_latencies, and treats dropped/no-transcript rounds as warning
A2 defaults to --full-chain-long-sentence-count 14/about one minute and validates partial preview content quality (prefix CER <= 0.5) via validate_capsule_evidence
Capsule validation failure produces warning, not hard fail
Default matrix execution stops at the first fail or fail-on-warning warning
A1/A2 product-chain checks reuse Listener-Type native BLE stream/ASR/insertion smoke
known_limits: Product-chain validation requires sibling Listener-Type repo, working ASR, and real device
Environment, reconnect, cancel, physical-key, soak, and RF edge cases now require separate targeted validation rather than this simplified matrix
Capsule visual details (exit animation, compact text truncation) require manual visual verification
Capsule validation depends on smoke report exposing partial_preview_count/last_partial_preview fields

features.summary: Extreme-use stability contract and named matrix suite for rapid short recordings, 60s fast long recording, cancel/retry, BLE recovery, stale GATT/cache, Listener-Type restart, EC11/KEY1-KEY4 stress, idle/resume, silence negative case, and diagnostic export evidence.
evidence: CASE_SUITES exposes a named extreme suite without editing the script by hand.
CASE_CONTRACTS records scenario, expected user-visible behavior, firmware/desktop observables, failure classification, and artifact requirements for every extreme case.

Matrix result JSON includes schema voice_keyboard_extreme_matrix_result.v1 plus firmware/Listener-Type commit metadata, optional Listener package SHA256, case contracts, skipped manual/external baselines, failure timestamps, and artifact requirements.
A1/A2 product-chain details standardize timeline, history_session_id, packet counters, firmware diag/serial refs, and Listener-Type log refs.
invariants: Existing auto/smoke/daily/full suites keep the accepted A1,A2 low-cost baseline.
The extreme suite records manual/external cases as skipped baselines until locked real-device or dedicated automation evidence exists; skipped is not PASS.
Hardware, serial, BLE, physical-key, idle/sleep, and diagnostic-export closure must use workflow locks and durable artifacts.
UX latency and product-chain startup/package identity are recorded as separate evidence surfaces.
known_limits: A14, A15, A17, T1, T3, L1, H1, H4, and D1 are contract/skipped baselines in this firmware-only harness step until later automation or manual locked evidence closes them.
Product-chain A1/A2 still require sibling Listener-Type repo, ASR configuration, Windows BLE state, and real hardware for execution.
Physical EC11 and KEY1-KEY4 stress cannot be honestly automated without external hardware operation or a validated injection fixture.
